title: Cryopreservation of Kidney Tissue
author: Michael Eadon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8rihv4e

steps.title: Acclimate tissue to OCT
steps.instruction: Place 0.5–10 mm kidney pieces (up to three pieces) in OCT medium and acclimate for 3 minutes (00:03:00). Transfer the tissue to a cryomold containing partially frozen OCT at the bottom of the mold on a block of dry ice, then completely cover the tissue with OCT while avoiding bubbles.

steps.title: Freeze block and package
steps.instruction: Allow the OCT to freeze completely. Wrap the frozen tissue block tightly in parafilm to expel all air, place the wrapped block in a sealed bag, and store the bag at –80 °C.

steps.title: Apply RNase‑free precautions
steps.instruction: Wear clean disposable gloves and a face mask. Clean all work surfaces with RNAse Away (Ambion, Cat #10328011) to limit RNA contamination.

steps.title: UV‑treat LMD slides
steps.instruction: Expose 1.2 µm Leica PPS‑membrane slides (Leica, Cat #11505268) to UV light in a tissue‑culture laminar‑flow hood for 30 minutes immediately before cryosectioning, then store the slides at room temperature for optimal tissue adherence.

steps.title: Prepare cryostat and blade
steps.instruction: Cool the cryostat to –22 °C, clean the work surfaces, and install a new cutting blade.

steps.title: Set up slide storage box
steps.instruction: Clean a small slide box with RNAse Away and place it inside the cryostat chamber to hold freshly cut slides.

steps.title: Mount specimen in cryostat
steps.instruction: Adhere the OCT‑embedded specimen to a tissue holder, then allow it to equilibrate for a few minutes until it reaches the chamber temperature, strengthening adhesion; use a heat extractor if needed.

steps.title: Section tissue for downstream uses
steps.instruction: Cut the specimen at the following thicknesses and allocate sections as indicated:

substeps.instruction: 12 µm – 2 sections: place in an Eppendorf tube for bulk analysis.

12 µm – 8 sections: affix to specialized Leica LMD slides (one nephrectomy section per slide or two biopsy sections per slide); store at –80 °C with a Bel‑Art desiccant cartridge (Cat #F42046-0000) and keep the slide box sealed in a Ziplock® bag.
12 µm – 1 section: affix to a glass slide for Periodic acid‑Schiff staining.
12 µm – 2 sections: reserve for miRNA analysis.

12 µm – 6 sections: affix to PEN‑membrane LMD slides (for proteomics, one nephrectomy section per slide or two biopsy sections per slide); store at –80 °C with a desiccant cartridge prior to shipment to OSU.

50 µm – 2 sections: place in a tissue‑culture plate with 4 % PFA for 24 hours, then transfer to a scintillation vial containing 0.25 % PFA for long‑term storage at 4 °C. All sections from the same donor may share the same container.

steps.title: Label and store cut slides
steps.instruction: Label each slide with the specimen ID, date, and slide number. Store slides at –80 °C with a Bel‑Art desiccant cartridge (Cat #F42046-0000) inside a tightly closed Ziplock® bag.

steps.title: Use slides within recommended time
steps.instruction: Process or analyze slides within 10 days of cryosectioning.

steps.title: Ship specimens for external processing
steps.instruction: Ship tissue on dry ice overnight (Monday‑Thursday) so that it arrives at the destination facility on the following business day.
